quarterly_data.signal: VNET 6-K (Exhibit 99.1): closing of the previously announced purchase by PJ Millennium I Limited and PJ Millennium II Limited of 650,424,192 Class A ordinary shares of VNET from Success Flow International Investment Limited and Choice Faith Group Holdings Limited. The buyers are wholly owned by PJ Millennium Limited Partnership, whose general partner is a subsidiary of Lochpine Capital Limited, which the release describes as a non-controlled, non-consolidated affiliate of Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL). After the closing the buyers hold approximately 38.1% of VNET's ordinary shares, and the investor rights agreement and a voting and consortium agreement with founder and Executive Chairperson Josh Sheng Chen became effective. Under the investor rights agreement (Exhibit 99.2) VNET will use commercially reasonable efforts to support the buyers and their affiliates in advancing the computing-power-electricity coordination strategy and to assist them in consolidating their professional know-how in the AIDC sector.
quarterly_data.figure: 650,424,192 Class A shares; buyers hold ~38.1% of VNET
